info.name: Factset Analytics Datastore About Lead API
Factset Return Lead Underwriters for a Fixed Income Security.

params.name: ids
params.description:
List of Fixed Income Security identifiers. Supported symbol types include CUSIP, SEDOL, ISIN, and FactSet Security Permanent Identifier (-S).

**ID LIMIT = 250** *per request*.

items.docs: Returns Lead Underwriters for the Fixed Income security.
